steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F); line a large baking dish with parchment paper.
Slice the tops off Bell peppers and remove seeds; place peppers upright in the baking dish.
Dice Onion finely and mince Garlic.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; add Onion and Garlic and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add Ground turkey; cook for 6 to 7 minutes, breaking it up, until fully browned with no pink.
Stir in Cooked lentils, Crushed tomatoes, Ground cumin, and Sweet paprika; simmer for 4 minutes until thickened.
Spoon the filling evenly into the 4 Bell peppers; top each with Mozzarella.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until peppers are tender and cheese is melted and golden.
Serve one stuffed pepper per adult portion, halved for toddlers. Refrigerate for up to 2 days.
